## Description

Previews floor plans and room elevations as SVG before anything is drawn in ZWCAD: renders the plan straight from DWG entities, overlays rooms/doors/windows from a ground truth or proposal, derives room metadata (rooms.json / walls.json / space-info.json) from the reviewed ground truth, and draws interior elevations of one room or every room at once (living room, kitchen, bedrooms, dress room ...). Supports Korean-speaking users. Use when: the user wants to see a plan or an elevation as SVG first, check an elevation before drawing it, regenerate elevation metadata, or draw all room elevations together.
